# Tejas Mellimpudi Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Mellimpudi Tejas — a BITS Pilani dual degree student (M.Sc. Physics + B.E. Computer Science) building robotics, quantum computing tools, and full-stack web systems.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero, about, skills, services, projects, experience, testimonials, blog, and contact form.

## About

Tejas is an avionics & electronics engineer on the Vanguard Mars Rover team, a robotics engineer with the ARC club, and a research associate with the Spectrum physics club at BITS Pilani. Featured projects include QUICKIDE (a quantum programming IDE), LIVEMART (MERN e-commerce), My-QuCPL (custom quantum programming language), and Agentic-AI-Lynq.
